jobs.title: For retailers
jobs.description: Skip to content Increasingly complex and costly last-mile operations. 41% of logistics costs are from last-mile delivery 75% of customers will spend more with brands offering excellent delivery experiences 52% of retailers provide the delivery visibility customers expect WHY BRINGG FOR RETAILERS Exceed customer expectations, profitably. Smart, always on-time delivery promises Unified delivery execution across fleets Real-time tracking and performance monitoring Consistent customer communication and branded experiences Dynamic, fast-to-deploy and expand solutions BRINGG LAST-MILE SOLUTIONS Automate, optimize, and reinvent the last mile. Win at the front door with Bringg Last-Mile Solutions. CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE Reduce cart abandonment and increase loyalty with accurate, reliable delivery. Offer more delivery options, avoid over-booking, and reduce WISMO calls with dynamic delivery slots, self-scheduling, real-time tracking, and notifications. OPERATIONAL EFFICIENCY Optimize every order, no matter the fleet. Streamline planning, dispatch, and driver management with automated workflows and real-time data that increases efficiency, cuts costs, and improves owned and third-party fleet performance. FLEET FLEXIBILITY Simplify multi-carrier management. Scale delivery capacity fast. Connect to 250+ carriers in 70+ countries through a single platform. Adapt to seasonal demands while ensuring a consistent customer experience. VISIBILITY & CONTROL Streamline complex processes. Improve performance. Gain real-time visibility with end-to-end automation and unified customer data. Track delivery performance and enhance shopper experiences with advanced analytics. Automation-first platform optimizes efficiency Centralized view across carriers, clients, and systems Expand last-mile service levels Fast, flexible integrations Improve order accuracy and fulfillment times CUSTOMERS Trusted by enterprise retail and logistics providers BRINGG LAST-MILE SOLUTIONS Meet logistics challenges head-on with unified, dynamic last-mile solutions. SHOPPER EXPERIENCE Differentiated last-mile experiences. Provide retail clients best-in-class delivery experiences that increase cart conversion and customer satisfaction. Precise and narrow delivery windows for ultimate accuracy Real-time order tracking and notifications from checkout to delivery Client-branded experience OPERATIONAL EFFICIENCY Scalable, consistent operations. From planning to dispatch to driver management, automated work streams increase efficiency and drive cost-effective delivery. Intuitive driver app with custom workflows, automated notifications, and clear delivery instructions all in one place No-code automation handles routine tasks across the entire delivery process FLEET FLEXIBILITY Single carrier integration, absolute flexibility. Maximize last-mile capacity utilization across all retail clients and across owned and outsourced fleets. One integration connects to 250+ carriers Manage and monitor performance from one platform VISIBILITY & CONTROL Real-time performance visibility. Gain real-time visibility with end-to-end automation and unified customer data. Use advanced analytics to track delivery performance and enhance shopper experiences. Reduce miles driven and increase first-attempt delivery success with real-time insights into every order Lower operating costs with intelligent routing and scheduling for the optimal delivery path WHY BRINGG FOR 3PLS Real solutions, built for performance and growth. LTL and truckload provider eliminates paper-based processes, optimizing planning and routes. Problem Paper-based dispatch, an outdated TMS, and a disjointed tech stack limited efficiency, visibility, and control across the entire terminal network. Solution Results Transportation leader deploys smarter routing; maximizes capacity and increases driver and technician loyalty. Problem Disconnected systems and manual processes limited delivery capacity and increased dissatisfaction among skilled technicians. Solution Results Global freight provider achieves over 99% on-time delivery for complex big and bulky orders. Problem Big and bulky deliveries with complex service levels made it difficult to match rising customer expectations for fast, flexible, Amazon-like delivery experiences. Solution Results 3PL provider shortens delivery windows by 50% with automated workflows and efficient driver app. Problem Outdated, manual processes blocked white glove growth, strained dispatch and drivers, and led to lost business. Solution Results LTL leader scales white-glove delivery services nationwide, achieves 5% delivery-cost reduction. Problem Manual processes and siloed fleets made it costly and inefficient to scale big and bulky white glove deliveries nationwide. Solution Results See how it works. jobs.title: Platform Shopping Experience Plan Dispatch Drive Delivery Experience
jobs.description: Skip to content WHY THE BRINGG PLATFORM Modular, extensible design. Fully configurable. Bringg redefines last-mile delivery with a unified platform designed for seamless coordination, unmatched flexibility, and real-time insights. Standardize operations for owned, 3PL, and hybrid fleets Accelerate decision-making with real-time data and insights Deliver exceptional experiences that drive customer loyalty BRINGG PLATFORM MODULES End-to-end control delivers exceptional experiences and maximum efficiency. Connect planning, routing, dispatch, and driver management to customers' shopping and delivery experiences. SHOPPING EXPERIENCE Turn window shoppers into repeat customers. Optimize delivery options, experience, and conversions during shopping and checkout. Dynamic delivery slots: Display precise delivery windows based on real-time order data, driver schedules, capacity, and more. On-demand delivery: Present real-time ETA for on-demand delivery options at checkout. Self-service scheduling: Allow customers to select preferred delivery options, post-purchase, via SMS and email. PLAN Plan accordingly. Resource management and route optimization across fleets, service levels, and orders. Route optimization: Continuous optimization across all customers, stop types, and service levels Route planner: Visualize routes and preview KPI impacts, like distance, utilization, and drivers Resource management: Configure and manage all resource types and costs Carrier selection: Select best-fit options based on defined business rules DISPATCH Smarter send-offs. A single-pane view of order progress and exceptions. Delivery monitoring: Real-time maps of owned and third-party fleets include order details and progress Exception management: Set up custom alerts and exception handling workflows Driver communication: Live driver tracking, automated push notifications, and chat Automated dispatch: Automatically dispatch on-demand orders into live routes based on cost, resource availability, labor skills, and SLAs DRIVE Happy, efficient drivers. Easy-to-use iOS and Android applications enhance driver productivity, improve communication, and ensure proof of delivery. Driver workflow management: Customized task, inventory, and customer-level workflows ensure quality and efficiency. Driver toolbox: A no-code, configurable in-app experience simplifies drivers' daily operations. Delivery visibility: Hands-free, geofence-powered delivery visibility with automated push notifications, chain of custody, and proof of delivery . DELIVERY EXPERIENCE Exceptional delivery experiences, every time. Win at the front door with real-time order visibility and customer communication. Branding: Consistent, branded delivery experiences across carriers and channels Notifications, tracking, and ETAs: Configurable pre-delivery text and email notifications with live driver tracking and dynamic ETAs in owned communication channels Customer ratings: Proactive customer-rating notifications with the ability to insert comments and action real-time feedback BRINGG FOUNDATIONAL CAPABILITIES Built for the enterprise on an automated, intelligent, and secure foundation. AUTOMATION CENTER Automate alerts, responses, decisions, and workflows. Configure and automate routine actions and decisions across the entire last mile. No code, custom development, or long lead times required. Trigger hundreds of actions across each Bringg Platform module Design custom workflows with the support of the Bringg Services team Power unique automation, reporting, and insights with custom data attributes INTELLIGENCE Gain actionable insights across systems. Comprehensive and customizable dashboards, reporting, and insights provide performance and profitability recommendations. Improve driver productivity, planning, and delivery experiences with real-time KPI visibility into cost, profit, driver performance, ratings, and more Import data from other systems, customize reporting and export data into other business intelligence and reporting tools Use cross-module data and increase productivity throughout the last mile SECURITY & CONNECTIVITY Secure data connections across internal and external systems. Enterprise-grade security and connectivity delivers unparalleled scale. Connect existing systems (OMS, ERP, eCommerce, WMS, TMS) with Bringg’s open REST APIs and webhooks Multi-factor authentication, support for SSO integration, SOC 2 compliance, and robust webhook restore and retry process Google Cloud infrastructure for rapid customer expansion The last-mile platform built for performance. 20% Last-mile delivery cost savings 40% Faster retail picking 87% Automated order-dispatch increase 30% Increase in deliveries per day 40% Higher CSAT Real-world Bringg customer results BRAD HOVE & BRAD PREVATT, BEST BUY “We don’t replace these large legacy platforms often. When we do, we have to get it right.” ​“That’s where Bringg came into play.” Network A single integration to more than 250 carriers across 70 countries removes the multiple carrier integrations burden. Services From implementation, to ongoing insights and advisory, Bringg Services supports continuous cost optimization and operational efficiency improvements. Talk to a Bringg expert.
